title: lycium tenuispinosum var. friesii
intro: Lycium tenuispinosum var. friesii, commonly known as a type of boxthorn, is a plant species belonging to the nightshade family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antidiabetic properties. The therapeutic actions of Lycium tenuispinosum var. friesii are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce oxidative stress, and improve glycemic control. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been isolated and characterized in various studies.
